description: All points are on longitude 0, so a straight line is the Earth's radius (6,371,008.8 m) times the difference of latitude in radians: 0.001 degrees is 111.19508 m, a walk of 111.19508 x 1.33 / 80 = 1.8486182 minutes. The matrix has no way from station 0 to station 1 (65535), and the direct walk of 0.2 degrees is far beyond reach, so there is no estimate.
